quarter_phase_normalization: phase modulo 2pi; k*pi/4 maps to [], T, S, Z+Tdg, Z, Z+T, Sdg, Tdg; general XPhase becomes H-ZPhase-H
two_q_definition: CNOT count plus CZ count after normalization
depth_definition: ASAP logical gate layers with unit duration for each normalized gate; no routing
t_count_definition: literal T and Tdg count after canonical quarter-phase normalization; null for QFT
non_clifford_rotation_definition: normalized single-qubit Z phases that are not multiples of pi/2

timing.method_order: Gate-only then ZX for even repetitions; ZX then Gate-only for odd repetitions
timing.includes: input copy, conversion, simplification, extraction graph copy, extraction, pre-cleanup normalization, cleanup and final normalization as applicable
timing.excludes: common raw-input normalization, artifact capture/serialization/I-O, metrics, hashing, equivalence verification
timing.output_validation: QASM hash equals the independently verified quality output, otherwise independently verify that timed output

verification.method: independent dense gate-action simulator, all computational basis inputs

scope: Exploratory 33-input Stage 1. No hardware routing, approximate Clifford+T synthesis, or extraction-direction comparison.
